[b]For the happiness of all | [sub]Caas-Ipsen Hall, Stormhaven, Norrhollow | 22 February 2025[/sub][/b]

Following its diplomatic triumph over Thrømm nationalists in the Austmark Crisis, the Albic Ministry of Foreign Affairs had been in relatively high spirits. In the halls of Ipsen Hall at the Norrhollower capital of Stormhaven, a similarly festive mood had taken root among members of the state-level government, where Norrhollow Govenor Eske Fjällstra had been presiding over a private dinner function of the state's political giants to celebrate the groundbreaking ceremony for the first of many development projects that was due to begin on the island proper.

Seated among them were the affluent Almstedt siblings Xavier and Honor Almstedt, said to have been the chief architects of Austmark Island's annexation; Mors Stillebrann, the Albic Minister of Environment who helped with the new land development projects over Austmark; Vivian Ravnskald, the CAUSE Commander who led the occupation of Austmark; and lastly Alice Ostman herself, the hot-headed Albic Minister of Foreign Affairs that weaponized High Albany's Radical-dominated House of Representatives to bring Thýven into diplomatic negotiations.

After Fjällstra's long speech to initiate the function, the dignitaries retreated to their tables to eat and drink on Norrhollow's finest Albic-Thrømm cuisine. A gentle tune on a violin emanated throughout Ipsen Hall to set the mood. However, in a corner of the function hall, three figures were patiently huddled together, not to discuss the triumphs of the Austmark crisis or other political messes, but matters far beyond that.

[list]"If we want to secure safety and tranquility for the people of Vesperia, we should look north."[/list]

The man spoke softly, adjusting his glasses as he kept low to the table. He was of thin and delicate framing. Long black hair, crystal blue eyes in the image of an open blue sky. Neat woolen clothes, a cape signifying his dignified lineage, and a traditional Norrhollower beret. The man's name was Xavier Almstedt, the CEO and President of Norrhollow's great Almstedt Corporation, and he had gathered together two other colleagues to discuss what seems to be High Albany's foreign affairs strategy moving forwards. They had triumphed in securing control over a puny island. Now, Xavier sought greater fortunes further beyond.

[list]"Varkadun is a good start." Xavier reasoned out. "It's never low on soldiers and weapons, since it has both available in every single household, in every single crummy little backwater suburban or profligate suite. Their obedience will mean tranquility for High Albany and all the people of Vesperia."

"Tranquility? Heh, go ahead and tell that to their face, Xavier..." One of the two women chuckled softly in response. It was Honor Almstedt, Xavier's older sister and the acting lieutenant acting governor of Norrhollow. As far as appearances and clothes go, she was identical to her brother, only shorter and sturdier built. "The Varkadi are a very macho nation. A stand-up guy like you shouldn't talk about subduing them like they're chattel, that isn't very PC..."

"Oh shut up Honor, the Varkadi ... Miss Ostman, what do you think?"[/list]

There, the Almstedts turned to the final figure at the table. Alice Juno Ostman, the Minister of Foreign Affairs. She was a pale-faced woman, with short, winter blonde hair that contrasted her deep purple eyes. She wore a downcast and sullen expression that complemented her mournful black outfit that she always wore. She stared at the siblings silently, shifting in her seat in thought. 

"I think that the Varkadi are brutes in need of discipline, Mr. Almstedt. It is for this reason that Ms. Almstedt is so wary about such benign language in their presence..." The Minister spoke bluntly and crassly, clearly haven't learned absolutely nothing from the controversy surrounding her equally hawkish tongue during the high of the Austmark crisis. "And yet..." Ostman paused. "It is true that the Varkadi are important to High Albany as partners. I don't exactly find much excitement in their export markets, but their military prowess alone can be a check against the UREV and Thýven."

[list]

"Hell yeah they are!" Xavier acclaimed. "We should negotiate something ASAP, Minister. Maybe joint-training exercises? Collective security? A common market? With some Almstedt leverage of course..."

"Maybe twinning a few cities here and there? Cultural events? Xavier, we need Varkadun to care about High Albany first!" Honor opined.

"They'll care about us once we show that we got the moolah to back things up Honor. I mean, seriously, since when did anyone ever care about twinned cities? Apart from foreign affairs offices anyway."

"Oh, sure, because sending our men over onto foreign soil without so much as even the slightest morsel of intercultural integration is [i]so[/i] much better?"

[/list]

"I'm fine with both ideas equally." Ostman suddenly interjected. "Following the Austmark mess, Ways and Means had established that any military surplus should be reappropriated by Foreign Affairs in defense against illegal aliens. We now have a good amount of unspent budget with which to pursue mandates independent of what had been declared in our budget for this first quarter. That said... Varkadun?"

[list]

"Yeah, Varkadun." Xavier affirmed. "Varkadun has gold deposits, soldiers, and a celebratory mood thanks to the recent triumph."

"Oh right there was that triumph a week ago!" Honor exclaimed, as if just now remembering. "Who was it again? Variance something?"

[/list]

"Varian Marzath, his name's Varian Marzath... ugh, those brutes and their high-strung names..." Ostman lamented. "Alright Mr. Almstedt, I'll play ball with you. A good friend of mine in the Ministry tells us that the Varkadi are in want of a good navy. High Albany is rich in coal and steel, and it is currently one of the premier powers in the White Sea. We have everything they could possibly need and more, all without posing any direct threats to their interests, being as we rule over the other side of the Channel. Though, I need assurances. Good ones."

[list]

"Assurances?"

"Assurances that they will work according to our interests. If we do this, I do not want the Varkadi to then starting harping on about how we're infiltrating their society with our companies or pulling us into wars across the Channel."

"I have SummitONE Solutions to handle anything that might require brawn, Miss Ostman." Mr. Almstedt reassured, bringing up Almstedt Corporation's private military subsidiary.

"SummitONE is a PR disaster in the making, but fine. Better journalists and missing person reports than patriotic soldiers and death certificates."

[/list]

"Haha, I knew you'd see reason Miss Ostman!" Xavier bellowed loudly in celebration before quieting his voice. "... Uh, not that I was suggesting you were being unreasonable before... but trust me, you won't regret it. Just do this one little thing, and I promise you that Almstedt Corporation will be your eyes and ears in this dark and immoral world. The Varkadi will get their pretty ships and cannons too, so it'll be a win-win for us and for the whole White Sea! Here, this is the file I prepared. I crunched the numbers a day after Austmark got annexed, it holds all the key industries willing to participate in an Almstedt-led initiative to invest in the Varkadi."

Xavier quietly took out a small envelop which had been resting on his lap beneath the table during their whole conversation, and would slide it quickly over to Honor, who passes it to Ostman. She takes the envelop and, without a moment's hesitation, rips it open to reveal its contents. In addition to a georeferenced map of Varkadun itself, it included some of its major urban hotspots, major industries, notes from Albic industry leaders, along with the long and winded list of Albic companies willing to pool capital into direct investments within Varkadun itself, with plans for offices to be opened in Maraz Dun and beyond. Even agricultural corporations that dominate the Transalbic River seem to be interested, noting the country's relatively flat geological profile.

[list]

"... these are huge numbers you're citing, Mr. Almstedt."

"Huge numbers, yes. I'm intent on opening the floodgates. Hell, maybe even setup some special economic zones along the way, get the ball rolling."

"Varkadun is a martial society." Ostman cautioned. "I don't think feeble men in sharply dressed suits from across the channel will be something that'll inspire Varkadun's floodgates to open."

"But the coal and steel will."

[/list]

[b]To the warriors from across the channel[/b]

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the Commonwealth of High Albany has expressed an intent on expanding its preexisting relationship with the Varkadun Martial Republic, citing its strategic position in the White Sea and its honorable military tradition, which it views as key pillars in the pursuit of important allies in Erene's rapidly intensifying geopolitical climate. After a brief session at the House of Representatives, the White Sea Caucus of Radicals would succeed in passing a resolution with the backing of much of the Radical Party and some left-leaning Moderates, expressing their intent on expanding High Albany's role as a global investor.

To facilitate this process, the Ministry would request a formal meeting with Varkadun in order to broker an expanded bilateral partnership aimed at breaking down barriers to entry in Varkadun's highly militarized society, with clearly defined goals of potentially setting up Albic firms within Varkadi soil under much greater economic liberties. In particular, Ostman would express an interest in increasing exports of its metallurgical output to Varkadun in return for negotiations on potential investment protection agreements, tax incentives, and other joint ventures to increase Albic confidence in Varkadi markets and encourage business trips to the nation.

Having just got off the recent successes of the Austmark Crisis, this Radical-led investment initiative would accepted through an identical resolution in the Senate, with leading industry leaders like Almstedt Corporation, Dearborn Bank, and CIO Group all expressing interest in participating in this sudden surge of interest in Varkadun.

[nation]Varkadun[/nation]
[nation]High Albany[/nation]

[quote=varkadun;58566672][b][] A New Trade Offer [] Erene 2000 RP [][/b]

[i]Following a round of military inspections and reforms, Consul Kaelus Dragan has noted that while Varkadun's power on land is formidable, their naval power is underwhelming. As such, his co-Consul Varia Thorne has seen fit to invite Representative Minister Wallace H. Achebe of the United Lavian Republic to Maraz Dun to negotiate a deal in which the ULR will assist Varkadun in improving their naval prowess in return for a thriving trade between the two nations.[/i]

[nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation][/quote]

[i]Minister Achebe has received the invitation, and plans to travel to Maraz Dun with a few navy representatives to discuss the deal. The populace boasts a generally good opinion of Varkadun, with 47% saying they approve or highly approve of the country's government. [/i]

In accordance with the constitution of the Republic of Estell, the bill was blocked by the parliament. -The Republic of Estell extradites all representatives of the highest nobility of the [nation]Gendarme[/nation] who fled to the Republic after the start of the war.
 -[nation]North Arenenge[/nation] will help in the construction of a new city and infrastructure in Estell by sending its people to the construction, their rights and salaries will be the same as our citizens, even a little more.
-The Republic of Estell in exchange for this will pay [nation]North Arenenge[/nation] 5,000,000 estel and will deliver a batch of weapons in the near future (Including tanks, armored personnel carriers and drones)

[i] As limousines and other such cars pull up to the entrance and each lets out their royal or other important human cargo, a sole red muscle car parks on a reserved spot across the street of the venue, along with a black SUV behind them. The cars appearance is nothing astounding, quite plain even, other than the two small flags on the front above each headlight boasting the flag of the ULR and Greater Lavia respectfully, and the Lavinsworth family royal crest on both doors. A younger man, maybe 30 or so dressed in a simple suit paired with a white beret, and a woman in a black dress, perhaps mid 30s, step out of the car with four men stepping out of the SUV that parked behind them. As the couple and guards walk across the street, one is standing closer to the two than the others, with the men seemingly talking with each other. As they approach the entrance, their conversation becomes somewhat audible to the photographers and others outside the venue. [/i]

Herman III: I do understand the concerns, but what do I have to fear? We have been neutral for decades, and we dont have any quarrels with other nations besides perhaps a select few vocal people on the internet opposing the deployment of Blue Dove aid workers to the ongoing war. [i] He gestures as he talks, his tone somewhat like hes talking to an old friend about a small annoyance.
